title: MiqraBERT: Regression-Based Sentence-BERT Finetuning for Biblical Hebrew Parallel Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses specifically on detection of textual reuse and intertextuality in the Hebrew Bible (Old Testament). It involves theological and hermeneutical analysis, such as evaluating how different biblical books (e.g., Chronicles vs Samuel-Kings) adapt and reinterpret source material through theological revision and narrative parallels.
